question: Should OpenClaw adopt private Markdown link provenance plus the renderer-only `origin` context as the canonical shared Markdown Core/plugin-SDK contract for this Telegram fix?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but it changes an exported renderer callback surface and establishes a cross-package metadata invariant that requires owner intent rather than automated repair.

options.title: Approve shared provenance contract

options.body: Pause the PR and require a narrower implementation if maintainers do not want provenance carried by shared Markdown Core objects.
